meta.name: review-work
meta.description: Post-implementation review orchestrator. Launches 5 parallel background sub-agents: Oracle (goal/constraint verification), Oracle (code quality), Oracle (security), unspecified-high (hands-on QA execution), unspecified-high (context mining from GitHub/git/Slack/Notion). All must pass for review to pass. MUST USE before a PR handoff or when the user explicitly asks to review completed work. Triggers: 'review work', 'review my work', 'review changes', 'QA my work', 'verify implementation', 'check my work', 'validate changes', 'post-implementation review'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline_en: Automatically review completed work across quality, security, and goal alignment

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 启动 5 个并行后台子代理审查已完成的工作：核对目标与约束、查代码质量、查安全、实际运行程序做 QA、从 GitHub/git/Slack/Notion 提取上下文。全部通过才算通过，任一项失败即整体失败。
howto.when: 在用户明确要求审查已完成的工作、或准备 PR 交接时触发。触发词如“review work”、“check my work”、“verify implementation”等。

howto.what_en: On install, Claude launches 5 parallel background sub-agents reviewing completed work: goal/constraint, code quality, security, hands-on QA, and context mining from GitHub/git/Slack/Notion. All must pass; one failure fails all.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user explicitly asks to review completed work (e.g., 'review work', 'check my work', 'verify implementation'), and should be used before a PR handoff.
